scope: Verify that versionless legacy Divider nodes honor shared responsive Inspector border properties through Canvas, draft Save and explicit Publish.

initial_regression.result: FAIL; legacy public renderer emitted its fallback after shared responsive styles, so the published Divider retained 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16) instead of the Inspector-authored 4px #e11d48.

fix.change: Emit the legacy Divider fallback first, then shared responsive styles, preserving the fallback while allowing explicit Inspector border overrides to win.

coverage: A versionless Divider fixture is selected through the real Inspector and its responsive.set command/key metadata is checked.
The Inspector border style, width and color render on Canvas.
Draft Save stores the border override while public CSS remains unchanged.
Explicit Publish updates public CSS to 4px solid rgb(225, 29, 72).
